_meta.status: DRAFT (Story Bot overnight_quests, not signed off by Gary)
_meta.placeholders: reward item ids and money are proposals; quest text is Story Bot draft text

steps.desc: Wake from the river dream. Check the bed and laptop if you like.
Talk to Ron downstairs: slow week, layoff rumours.
Walk to the Revival Tech field office. Reception sends you in.
The manager promotes you and Ron to field researchers. Field team missing; start in Fernwick.
Pick a partner at the Brookhollow lab: Nibbin, Cindrip or Rillop (level 5).
Optional: read the new company emails on the laptop (new_role, greystone_cancelled).

text: ...The river again. Cold water, and someone on the bank, watching.
Just a dream. Probably.
Morning. You look like you slept in the river.
Work's been dead all week. They cleared out three desks on Friday.
If layoffs are coming, I hope they wait till I've bought groceries.
Sit down. Relax, this isn't that conversation.
Our field team stopped reporting in. As of today, you two are field researchers.
Their last check-in was from Greystone Caverns. Start in Fernwick.
Ines Varga, lab lead. Three partners ready, none of them catalogued yet.
Pick the one that looks back at you. Ron gets whoever's left.
Good choice. Crystals and remedies are on the house. Just this once.
Fernwick's up Trail 1. Bring it back in one piece.
Field researchers. Us. I still think they mixed us up with someone else.
Fernwick's first. Try to keep up.

steps.desc: Talk to the gardener about the eaten beans.
Stake out the bean rows at Night and spot the culprit (a Tumbloam).
Leave Trail Mix at the end of the row so the Tumbloam has its own snack.
Tell the gardener.

text: Something's eating my beans. Neat little bites, every night.
Sit up tonight and catch the culprit? Gently. It's probably small.
A little ball-shaped creature rolls between the bean rows.
It's a Tumbloam, nibbling very politely.
You leave some Trail Mix at the end of the row.
The Tumbloam rolls over to it. Fair trade.
Night's when it comes. Bring a snack. It's only hungry, not bad.
A Tumbloam! I knew it. Polite little thief.
Here, my old watering can. Grow something of your own.

steps.desc: Get the aide's tip: meet five different creatures.
Meet five different species (seen, not caught) in the Kilindex.
Report back to the aide.

text: First field lesson: meet five different creatures.
Not catch. Meet. Then come tell me about them.
Grass, water, trees. They're all out there, hiding badly.
Five! And you didn't skip the boring ones.
Here, three crystals. Company issue. Meet first, then decide.

steps.desc: Hear the fisher out: the river's too low for his old lures.
Ask the fly-tier in Fernwick for a hand-tied fly.
Bring the fly back to the fisher.
Meet him on the bridge at Dusk to see it work.

text: River's too low for my old lures. Need something smaller.
Fella in Fernwick ties flies. Ask him for one?
A fly for the Brookhollow fisher? Twelve years, and finally a customer.
Take this one. It's the easy knot. My best knot.
Hand-tied. Look at that.
Come to the bridge at dusk. I'll show you how it's done.
Caught nothing. Best evening I've had all year.
Tell him the fly works. It's not a lie, exactly.

steps.desc: Inspect Ron's bin by the front door. Bin day is 'tomorrow'.
After each Master coin one more bag appears (up to 8; flies from bag 6). Text Bot's bin_1..bin_8 lines play; nothing to do.
Between coin 8 and the finale, inspect the full bin: E5 Bin Monument. 8 more presses and a Mirewump pops out (rare catch).
While Ron is travelling with you (all_badges to the finale), inspect the bin: Ron has one quip.
After the credits: the bin is empty. Inspect it (Text Bot bin_empty). Ron's payoff itself is main (mq_finale s8).

text: This is no longer a bin. It is a landmark.
Don't look at it, {nick}. It can tell when you look at it.

steps.desc: Check Dana's cleared desk: a second sticky note in odd shorthand.
Find Dana's unsent drafts in the company inbox (secret E3); they decode the shorthand.
Post-game: find Dana on Frostspire and battle her.

text: Under the 'soon' note there's another. Shorthand: 'FS. N face. Sat.'
Means nothing to you. Yet.
Unsent draft from Dana. Subject: 'Going up.'
'Frostspire. North face. Don't wait for me.'
You found the note. Took you long enough.
I didn't vanish. I quit. Then I climbed. Fancy a match?
Good fight. Here's my team card. Frame it or don't.
Tell the office I said hi. Actually, don't.

steps.desc: Read Ron's CV on the house_1f table.
Ron mentions an interview at the Lumen Line (gag).
Ron mentions an interview at a Saltmere fishmonger (gag).
Right after the layoff letter (main mq_revival_heights s4), if you talk to Ron again before the Master, he says one quiet line.
Post-game: Nan Wexley hires Ron part-time at the Croft.

text: Ron's CV. 'Skills: punctual (mostly), team player, bins.'
Someone has crossed out 'bins'.
Lumen Line wanted a conductor. I said 'all aboard' too loud.
Apparently there's a right volume.
Fishmonger job. I named every fish. They said that's 'a problem'.
Thanks for not saying anything. That helps, {nick}.
Ron, is it? Can you carry feed without naming it?
...Fine. Name it. You start Monday.
Part-time, {nick}! Real job. They use names here.

quests.title: The Kid's Last Joke

steps.desc: The kid's joke falls flat. His dad stopped laughing.
Visit the kid's dad at home in Brookhollow. He's reading job ads.
Take a 'We're hiring Care Associates!' form from a heal-centre suggestion box.
Give the form to the kid's dad.

text: Why did the crystal quit? ...I forget the rest.
Dad stopped laughing. He reads job ads at breakfast now.
Job ads. 'Must love paperwork.' I do not love paperwork.
A flyer: 'We're hiring Care Associates!'
You take a form. Nobody stops you.
Care Associate? Looking after creatures all day?
...I'd actually like that. Thanks.
Why don't Tumbloams get lost? They always know which way is down.
Dad laughed. Twice.

new_ids: brookhollow_kid_home (map, pending: a Brookhollow home for the kid and dad)

steps.desc: Head north up Trail 1. Three trainers on the trail (optional; see sq_fork_regulars).
Squeeze through the forced grass under Fernwick.
Ron is waiting in Fernwick. Battle him (Ron 1).
Ron hands over the Trail Runners.

text: There you are, {nick}. Bin day's tomorrow. It's fine.
The company says we're each other's benchmark. Let's see where you're at.
Don't sweat it. I'll go easy next time. Probably.
Here. Company Trail Runners. They gave me two pairs.
Don't ask why. I didn't ask why.
The Master's Hall is on the east side. I'm getting a sandwich first.

steps.desc: Beat trainer_r1_b; she dares you to beat the other two Trail 1 trainers.
Beat trainer_r1_a.
Beat trainer_r1_c.
Go back and gloat.

text: Not bad. The other two on this road think they're better than me.
Beat them both, then come back and gloat.
Still one left. I can see them from here, smirking.
Both of them? Ha! They'll never hear the end of it.
Trail Mix. Trainers' lunch. You earned it.

steps.desc: trainer_r1_c wonders what's past the Sunmeadow shine.
Once the barrier dims, pick a bloom in Sunmeadow Fields.
Bring it back to trainer_r1_c.

text: Every day I stare at that shine. What's even over there?
If it ever opens, bring me something back. Anything.
A flower. From the other side. It smells like... a flower.
Perfect. Have this Pep Remedy. Pricey stuff, so don't waste it.

steps.desc: Enter the Master's Hall on the east side of Fernwick.
Step on both corner plates to open the first gate.
Light all three crystals at once (each touch flips its neighbours).
Beat the two hall helpers (optional order).
Battle the Master of Fernwick (Earth).
Report the coin at the office. The manager points you at Greystone.

text: Two plates, one in each corner. Step on both and the first gate opens.
Past that, the crystals. Each one you touch flips its neighbours.
The middle one starts lit. Leave it alone at first.
Earth doesn't hurry, and neither do I. You took your time getting here.
Let's see if your team can stand its ground.
That coin registers you as a trainer. Brookhollow's east road is open to you.
Looking for your missing crew? Miners heard voices down in Greystone.
A coin already. Good. Keep the reports coming.
And keep looking for the field team. Greystone first.

quests.title: The Missing Note

steps.desc: Talk to the DJ at The Firefly (Dusk or Night). Four old records are missing.
Find an Old Record in Fernwick.
Find an Old Record in Thornwood.
Find an Old Record on Trail 1.
Find the last Old Record in Lanternport (map pending).
Bring all four back to the DJ.

text: Dreamed this tune years back. Five notes. I only ever get four.
Five notes, and the last one's gone. Reckon it's on an old record.
Four of mine went missing years back. Find them?
That's one! Hear that bassline? Always meant to be there.
Two. Strings now. Starting to sound like a river.
Three. Someone hummed this exact bit to me once. Odd.
Four. That's all of them. Let me stitch it together...
Take this firefly lantern. Warms up a room. Warms up a camp, too.
Still missing one. It'll turn up.
Last note turned up. Turns out the tune was always meant to end there.
Now THAT I can dance to. Badly.

new_ids: item_lanternport_old_record (pickup flag for the Lanternport map item)

steps.desc: The paint vendor has run out of greens, browns and reds.
Pick fern dye leaves in Thornwood.
Dig river clay from the Brookhollow riverbank.
Ask the juice counter for leftover fruit pulp.
Bring all three to the paint vendor.

text: Out of greens, browns and reds. Can't paint a Cindrip without red.
Bring me fern leaves, river clay and fruit pulp?
Fruit pulp? Left over from the shakes. Take the lot.
Fern, clay, fruit. That's three colours back on the shelf.
Free coat on any creature you like. Paint's cosmetic. Won't make anyone stronger.
Took me three weeks to get a Cindrip's shade right.

steps.desc: Read the MISSING flyer and its pinned notes at The Firefly.
Thornwood camp restored: tell the juice counter.
Greystone camp restored: tell the juice counter.
Frostspire camp restored: tell the juice counter.
Mirefen camp restored: tell the juice counter.
After the team is home, come back to The Firefly.

text: That flyer's been up a long time. Notes keep getting pinned to it.
Find anything out there, tell me first. I'll make it worth your while.
Thornwood camp? Someone was there. Not lately, but someone.
Pond Fruit Juice. On the house.
Greystone too. Bet the stove still works.
Moss Shake. Thick enough to stand a spoon in.
Frostspire? In that cold? Here, warm up.
Fern Mint Tea. My own blend.
Mirefen. That's every camp, then.
Firefly Shake. I only make these for big news.
You did it. Look at that flyer. Every name ticked.
Shakes for the whole room tonight. Even the bouncer smiled.

steps.desc: Patron_3 signed up for open mic with a dance they don't know.
Read the dance steps poster in the back room.
Step on the dance-floor tiles in order: left, left, back, spin.
Tell patron_3.

text: Open mic's coming. I'm doing a dance. I don't know a dance.
Someone pinned the steps up out back. Learn them, show me?
DANCE OF THE FIREFLY: Left. Left. Back. Spin.
(Spin optional. Dignity also optional.)
You stumble. Somebody claps anyway. Try again.
Left, left, back, spin... I've got it! Sort of.
Firefly Shake's on me. Don't tell Dov.

steps.desc: Read the LOST flyer at The Firefly: a Tumbloam called Biscuit.
Find Biscuit stuck below the Trail 1 ledges.
Go the long way around and come at Biscuit from above so it rolls toward the exit.
Bring the news to the owner.

text: Below the ledge, a Tumbloam rolls down, tries to climb, rolls down again.
It looks pleased with itself anyway.
You come at it from above. It rolls the right way, straight home.
Biscuit! You rolled off again, didn't you?
Thank you. It's not much. Biscuit says thanks too.

steps.desc: At Night, count the fireflies at the pond for the elder. Only 3 left.
Plant lumen moss in the Thornwood scar.
Plant lumen moss in the Greystone entrance scar.
Plant lumen moss in one more Greystone dig scar (spot TBD by World Design).
Count again at the pond at Night: 12 fireflies.

text: Count them with me? ...Three. There used to be dozens.
Lumen moss heals cut ground. Plant some where old crystal was dug out?
You press lumen moss into the scar. It glows, faintly.
You press lumen moss into the scar. It glows, faintly.
You press lumen moss into the scar. It glows, faintly.
Three scars, I'd guess. The land remembers every one.
Count again. ...Ten, eleven, twelve. Twelve!
Let me teach you Glowcall. Dark places won't seem so dark.

steps.desc: The ex-courier still has one parcel he never delivered.
Deliver it to the house with the kettle in Brookhollow.
Tell the ex-courier.

text: My last parcel. Never got delivered. Then the job went.
Brookhollow, the house with the kettle. Would you?
A parcel? For me? Postmarked two years ago.
A new kettle whistle! Now it can sing again.
Delivered. My trail's finally done. Thank you.
Take these. Couriers always carry spares.

steps.desc: The kid wants a scary sign for the fort.
Ask the painter at The Firefly (Dusk or Night).
Bring the sign to the kid.

text: My fort needs a sign. A scary one.
The painter at the club could do it. Ask?
A fort sign? Scary? Leave it with me.
Done. 'KEEP OUT (please).' Manners matter.
Perfect. Now nobody gets in. Unless they ask nicely.
You can come in. You know the password.

quests.title: Ferns Over the Tent

steps.desc: Take the Thornwood trail east of Fernwick. The dissident at (23,7) has words for your company ID.
Find the empty tent under the ferns.
Clear the camp and light the stove.
Read the field log page tucked in the tent.
Rest at the stove with your team (first Warmth rest).

text: Revival Tech ID on your belt. Of course.
Ask your bosses what happens to the creatures they 'catalogue'.
Then ask why nobody comes back. The caves are right there.
An empty tent, ferns grown right over it.
Nobody's slept here in a long while.
You pull the ferns off the tent and sweep out the leaves.
The stove catches on the second try.
A field log page, damp at the edges. Signed 'I.S.'
'Night two. Teo made a list of his lists. I hummed till he gave up.'
'My partner's crystal looks less violet by the fire. Probably just the light.'
Your camp now. Stove's warm, tent's dry.
A good spot to sit a while with your team.

new_ids: prop:log_thornwood (interact spot inside the tent; World to place)

steps.desc: The bug catcher can't tell Burlbeetles from stumps.
Find the five stumps that blink.
Report the count.

text: Burlbeetles look like stumps. I've counted three. I think.
Find the ones that blink. Stumps don't blink.
The stump blinks at you. Then pretends it didn't.
Tap every stump. The real stumps won't mind.
Five! I'd counted two of those as actual stumps.
Here, a Vigor Seed. For keeping your eyes open.

steps.desc: The hiker by the blocked east trail is hungry.
Get a packed lunch from the juice counter at The Firefly.
Bring it back.

text: East trail's blocked and I've waited all day.
Didn't pack lunch. Didn't think I'd need it. Help?
Packed lunch for Thornwood? Sandwich and a Pond Fruit Juice. Off you go.
Sandwich! You're a hero. A small, sandwich-shaped hero.
Take this Pep Remedy. Bought it for the trip. Trip's off.

quests.title: Greystone First

steps.desc: Enter Greystone Caverns from Thornwood's north path. Talk to the hiker.
Go down to B1. Push the boulder onto the hold plate to open the north gate.
Find the cold camp stove in the far north of B1.
Clear the camp and light the stove.
Read the field log page under the bedroll.
Optional: the tally marks scratched into the crystal by the west wall (E7).
File a field report at any company terminal. Read the reply.

text: Those ferns glow when something walks through. Doesn't mean it's friendly.
A crew in Revival Tech jackets went down those stairs. Never saw them come up.
That plate hums when something heavy sits on it.
Standing on it yourself won't do it. You have to leave something there.
Line the boulder up before you push. It resets if you leave the floor.
You shake out the bedroll and brush off the dust.
The stove takes a few tries, then catches.
A list in tidy capitals, signed 'T.B.'
'CHECK-IN, DAY 9. 1. Seam found. 2. Samples bagged. 3. Readings odd again.'
'4. Odd only on our own four. 5. Ask Head Office. In person.'
Tally marks scratched into the crystal. Twenty-three of them.
Four sets of initials underneath. One of them is just a doodle of a fern.
Report received. Thank you for your diligence.
The Greystone check-in was cancelled by the organiser. No further action is needed.
Your camp now. Warm, for a cave.
A good spot to sit a while with your team.

new_ids: prop:log_greystone, prop:tally_crystal (interact spots; World to place, tally at (3,9) per SOUL_PLAYBOOK E7)

steps.desc: The hiker is sketching the caves and hates dead ends.
Check the west dead end.
Check the south-west dead end.
Check the north dead end on B1.
Check the east dead end on B1.
Report back.

text: I'm sketching the caves. Dead ends are the worst part.
Peek into four for me? Just tell me what's there.
Dead end. You make a note for the hiker.
Four dead ends. My map's finally honest.
Here, some crystal dust I dug up. Can't sketch with it.

steps.desc: The Fernwick elder asks you to take ferns to Old Hal's stone.
Lay the ferns at Old Hal's stone in the Lantern Rest.
Tell the elder.

text: Old Hal fixed my roof twice. Never charged me once.
He rests past Greystone now. Take him these ferns?
You lay the ferns by the stone. OLD HAL & CINDER.
Hal's got visitors. Good. Cinder would've chewed those ferns.
Thank you. Roof's still dry. That's Hal's doing.
I baked these for him. He'd want you to have them.

steps.desc: Show the coin at the east road. The guard hands you a survey parcel for Saltmere.
Take the east road to Aurelith (pass through; the arena is sealed), then south to Saltmere.
Deliver the parcel to the Saltmere office clerk. She lends you a Courier Bike.
Ron is outside the office, sore about your ID level. Battle him (Ron 2).
Beat the Master of Saltmere.

text: You're registered now. Road east is open. Mind the bridge, it creaks.
Heading east? Drop this parcel at the Saltmere office. They'll pay you back.
Saltmere's past Aurelith. The parcel's not getting any lighter.
Survey parcel, signed for. They said it'd be a week. It's been a season.
Take the Courier Bike. The boardwalks here are bikes only.
Your ID says 'Field Researcher II'. Mine says 'Field Researcher'.
No numeral. Just vibes. Let's fix that, {nick}.
One bag by the bin now. It's fine, {nick}.
Tomorrow.

steps.desc: Buy a lucky crystal from the seller in any city (1 of 4).
Buy another in a different city (2 of 4).
Buy another in a different city (3 of 4).
Buy another in a different city (4 of 4). A compliance memo lands in your inbox.
After the ending, visit the seller, who has finally gone honest.

text: Lucky crystal! Brings luck. Pretty much guaranteed.
Looks a lot like glass. That's how you know it's lucky.
Inbox: 'Unauthorised crystal resale under investigation. Please report sellers.'
You decide not to.
Clear crystals. 100% nothing.
Finally honest.
Your Glass Crystal does nothing. Your Trail Buddy loves it anyway.

steps.desc: Meet the harbour weigh-in host (any day).
On a Thursday, enter a creature of the featured species.
Beat the record holder on the board (heaviest OR lightest).

text: Thursdays we weigh creatures. Heaviest wins. Lightest also wins.
Bring the featured species. Crowd's free. Cheering's mandatory.
Not Thursday yet. The scales need their rest.
New record! Somebody fetch the chalk!
Here's your ribbon. It shows on the Kilindex card. Forever.

steps.desc: The ship-in-a-bottle builder snapped another mast.
Find a thin, straight twig in Thornwood's glade.
Bring it back.

text: Attempt forty-three. The mast snapped. Again.
Thornwood twigs grow thin and straight. Bring me one?
A twig as straight as a pencil. Perfect for a tiny mast.
Forty-four. It's in. It's standing. Don't breathe.
...Perfect. Take this pouch. I'd only spend it on more tiny ships.

quests.title: Head Office

steps.desc: With two coins, the fallen trunk on the Thornwood trail is cleared.
Follow the trail to Revival Heights (field staff use the long way round).
Ron catches up at the HQ plaza. Battle him (Ron 3).
Inside HQ reception, Ron opens a letter. Stay with him.
Beat the Master of Revival Heights.
The south gate guard opens the shortcut to Saltmere.
Collect the Lumen Line rail pass at Central station.

text: Only sawdust is left where the trunk was.
Someone carved 'FINALLY' into the stump.
Two bags. Maybe three. Doesn't matter.
Bin day's tomorrow. Let's go, {nick}.
Post for Ron? Hand delivered. Head Office likes paper.
It's fine. It's just a letter.
Go on, {nick}. The Master's waiting. I'll catch up.
You beat the Heights Master? Fine. I'll open it from this side.
Saltmere's straight down the hill. Saves you the long way.
Lumen Line pass, field grade. Every station that has one.
Skylift won't take you into the rail-only cities. Trains will.

new_ids: gate_thornwood_east_cleared (flag, if the blocker doesn't already set one)

steps.desc: A Revival Tech intern has lost their lanyard.
Look under the benches at the Lumen Line station.
Return it.

text: Lost my lanyard. No lanyard, no lift. No lift, no job.
Last had it at the station. Could you look?
Under a bench: a lanyard. 'INTERN. Smile! You're Revival Tech.'
My lanyard! I can take the lift again. Forty floors.
Have these. Lobby freebies. Everyone gets some.

quests.title: Rated for One

steps.desc: Take the Greystone pass north. The engineer approves the bridge for a three-coin trainer.
Ron is at the rebuilt bridge. Battle him (Ron 4, optional per GD).
Find the snowed-in camp below the shrine and restore it.
Read the log page pinned under a rock.
Beat the Master of Frostspire. Learn Skylift.
The shrine is lit again. Down the mountain, three crystal walls go dim.

text: The rope bridge has snapped. Both halves are hanging off the cliffs.
Engineer: Repairs get approved when someone with three coins asks.
The bridge has been rebuilt. New rope, new planks.
Engineer: Rated for one person at a time. So, one person at a time.
The bags froze to the bin last night.
That's basically storage. Ready, {nick}?
You dig the tent out of the drift and knock the ice off the stove.
It lights. Barely. Then properly.
A page in loopy handwriting, signed 'P.A.'
'Snowed in two nights. Went up to the shrine. It's gone quiet.'
'The crystals on the path hum instead. Teo wants it on the list.'
Far below, the violet walls flicker... and dim.

new_ids: gate_frostspire_bridge_open (flag, if the blocker doesn't set one)

steps.desc: A climber's hands are too cold to tie knots.
Bring something warm: Fern Mint Tea from The Firefly.
Give it to the climber.

text: Hands are too cold to tie a knot.
Anything warm? Tea, maybe? I'll make it worth your while.
Fern mint. That's the stuff. Fingers are back.
Take this Big Remedy. Mountains eat Small ones.

steps.desc: The Trail 1 east wall has dimmed. Walk through to Sunmeadow Fields.
Cross the meadow south-east toward Mirefen (or take the Saltmere causeway).

text: The violet wall is just glass now. Dim, and cold, and easy to walk past.

steps.desc: Read the Trail 1 sign: 'Wexley's Croft – past the shine'.
Find the Croft in Sunmeadow and meet Nan Wexley.
Herd three loose Tumbloams back into the paddock.
Tell Nan.

text: A visitor! Good. Three Tumbloams got out. Again.
Herd them back in? Come at them from uphill.
The Tumbloam rolls downhill, straight into the paddock.
All three. You've done this before, haven't you?
Croft's open to you now. Bring anyone who needs looking after.

quests.title: Not a Fisher

steps.desc: Ask the quiet angler on the boardwalk about the field notebook from the club flyer.
Follow the notebook's sketch map to the camp on the reed island (bike boards).
Restore the camp.
Read the last page of the notebook at the stove.
Ron's here, ankle-deep. Battle him (optional, Text Bot opener).
Beat the Master of Mirefen. Learn Tideglide. The storm season starts.

text: Fish? In this bog? No. I just like the quiet.
Stay on the boards. The mud takes boots and doesn't give them back.
The notebook? Didn't catch a fish. Caught that.
Someone drew a map in the back. Badly. Take it.
You haul the tent out of the reeds and wring it out.
The stove's dry inside. Someone wrapped it up properly.
Neat handwriting, signed 'M.Q.' The last page is dated.
'Bog census done by hand. The scanners don't like our four.'
'Off to Head Office with Teo's list. Back by Friday.'
This bog smells like bag five.
Bag five and I aren't speaking, {nick}.
Storm's got the whole bog stirred up.
Even the frogs went home.

new_ids: field_notebook (key item, also in sq_ask_nicely draft; now main)
beat_rival_ron_mirefen (flag, only if the battle stays)

steps.desc: After the Mirefen camp is restored, the angler is back on the boardwalk. Sit with them at dusk without talking.
Talk to them afterwards.

text: Found the camp, then. Good. Sit a while, if you like. Quietly.
You sit. The bog bubbles. Nobody says anything for ages.
It's nice, actually.
You can sit still. Rare, that.
Here. Tea's better than talking. Most days.
I just like the quiet.

steps.desc: Trade with Corwen on the bog islet at Night to get Purl, then read Purl's old letter at any heal-centre terminal.
Deliver the letter to Lune on Trail 1's high corner at Night and trade for Matins.
Deliver Lune's reply to Ivo below the caves and trade for Wick.
Take Wick to the Lantern Rest. His lantern brightens at one stone.

text: An old letter, never delivered. 'To L. Hartley, Trail 1, the high corner.'
Corwen's handwriting. Took the long way, didn't it?
Take my reply below the caves? To I. Stannard.
Lune still writes. Good.
Take Wick to the Lantern Rest. There's someone he'd like to see.
Wick's lantern brightens at one stone. It stays bright.
That's Ivo's Wick. Look at that lantern go.
Ivo asked me to frame this letter for you. Hang it somewhere warm.

steps.desc: The census clerk explains the daily Mirefen Count.
Check today's spotlight species on the company terminal.
Finish one count (20 nets, no battles; binoculars work as the scope).

text: Company census. Twenty nets, no battles, one scope.
Today's spotlight is on the terminal. Count carefully. Head office checks.
Clean count. Head office will love it. Or ignore it.
Come back tomorrow. The spotlight changes daily.

quests.title: Deep Enough to Lose a Boot

steps.desc: The storm has flooded the coast road south of Brookhollow. Cross it with Tideglide.
Ron is on the sea wall. Battle him (optional, Text Bot opener).
Beat the Master of Tidewater Coast.
Take the sea lane north to Lanternport.

text: The coast road is underwater. Deep enough to lose a boot. Maybe both.
The flies have names now.
Don't ask me their names, {nick}.

new_ids: beat_rival_ron_tidewater (flag, only if the battle stays)

steps.desc: A beachcomber collects sea glass, but the best bits are offshore.
Glide out and pick up three pieces of sea glass on the sandbars.
Bring them back.

text: The good sea glass washes up on the sandbars. Can't swim.
Three pieces? Green's my favourite. Any colour, really.
A piece of sea glass, worn smooth as a pebble.
Look at that green. Worn smooth as a mint.
